hypothesis: If per-token CPU dispatch overhead matters, one CPU thread will speed the same warmed model without changing any generated token. If GPU memory/kernel cost dominates, speed will not improve materially. End-of-turn/TTS delays are unaffected and must be reported separately.
gates: All30 raw outputs/actions/tokens exact to same-process controls, all source tensors/versions unchanged, reference return drift<=10%, median steady speed ratio>=1.2 before any real voice validation. No promotion from model-only timing.
